label: TEST: CX-8 rig and local test stack only. Not an owner decision and not a product default.

WS_MUX_IDLE_MS.note: TEST idle window of one minute for a multiplexed socket with no subscription, so the multiplexed /ws door mounts on the test stack (#8311). Blank in production leaves the door unmounted (ws.mux_idle_unset).

WS_MUX_MAX_SEATS.note: TEST multiplexed seat pool per hub, so a journey's subscriptions find a seat. Blank in production refuses the attach (ws.close.mux_max_seats_unset).

WS_MUX_MAX_SUBSCRIPTIONS.note: TEST channels per multiplexed connection. Blank in production closes the connection (ws.close.mux_max_subscriptions_unset).

WS_MUX_MAX_OPS_PER_SECOND.note: TEST inbound operations per second per multiplexed connection. Blank in production closes the connection (ws.close.mux_max_ops_per_second_unset).

WS_MAX_CONNECTIONS.note: TEST socket ceiling per hub, which the multiplexed door also checks before it accepts a connection. Blank in production refuses the attach (ws.max_connections_unset).

WS_HIGH_WATER_BYTES.note: TEST outbound buffer high-water of 1 MiB, which every multiplexed session checks when it starts. Blank in production refuses (ws.high_water_bytes_unset).
